### Title: THE APPLICATION OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN CRIMINAL PROCEDURE

Authors: Monika Porwisz  
Published in journal: 2025-06-25  

---

### 🪄 Explained Simply
<ns3:assistant>
This research explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can help speed up and lower the costs of criminal trials. To figure out where AI could be useful, we looked at laws from around the world and in Poland that define and describe AI's role. We also read through a lot of other studies on the topic. By examining these areas, we hope to suggest ways to apply AI that follow current legal guidelines.

---

### 📄 Original Abstract
<ns3:p>The purpose of this paper is to identify areas in which artificial intelligence (AI) can be applied in criminal procedure, with a view to improving the efficiency of proceedings in terms of both time and cost. Addressing the issues raised required a review of international and Polish regulations concerning the definition and conceptual use of AI, as well as a review of the relevant literature. The areas analysed were essential for indicating the directions for the application of AI in criminal procedure and for justifying the need to implement the proposed solutions in line with existing legal standards.</ns3:p>
